why.description: One sentence: what this change accomplishes.

assumptions.description: Anything you had to guess because the brief or the repo did not say. Be exhaustive and blunt; this is the first thing the reviewer checks.

concerns.description: Parts of your own work you are not confident in, and why. An empty list means you are certain of every line.

scope_respected.description: True only if every file you touched matches the declared scope globs.

tests_added.description: Repo-relative paths of test files added or extended.
